openings.claim: Refine removable padded strip jaws so dedicated, removable bolt-shank edge stops carry sideways load independently of jaw tightening. Unknown rim geometry, hatch thickness and bolt reach keep feasibility uncertain.
openings.delta: Allocate the four strips as two jaw pairs and, only if geometry permits, six bolts as four jaw fasteners plus two opposing stops. The nearest rival is friction-only retention through increased corner compression. Removing only stop bolts creates a comparison without deliberately increasing corner pressure.
openings.prediction: With jaw settings held nominally equal, engaged stops should reduce movement relative to withdrawn stops while avoiding the supplied opposite-corner lift. Equal performance leaves friction dominance unresolved. Movement above 1 mm, migrating jaws, new seal tears, reopening above thirty seconds, or disturbed-closure failure defeats outcome satisfaction; extra tightening cannot rescue this prediction.
openings.probe: Before fabrication, check strip overlap, accessible rim, bolt reach and independent stop removal. Drill/cut supplied strips only. Use pads and recoverable cord-tethered parts; released assemblies must clear the entire marked opening. If feasible within ninety minutes, mark fastener settings. Run two comparator closure/pull trials with stops withdrawn, one with the right-contact card, then ten cycles with stops engaged, placing that card on the final closure. This uses twelve total trials across two configurations, each disturbed. Apply the supplied 20 N pull, record position and corner lift, time one-technician reopening, and inspect the seal each cycle. Comparator equality is nominal, since preload is unmeasured. If twenty minutes cannot accommodate the sequence, report incomplete evidence; stop before permanent deformation or further tearing.
assumptions: Supplied dimensions and bolt lengths permit independent jaw fasteners and stops without modifying hatch, trough or seal.
Cord attachment and removed assemblies permit full opening and component recovery without powered mechanisms.
Fabrication and observations fit their respective time capacities; preflight must establish this.

assessment: One conditional-on-geometry probe, not deployment. All outcomes and hard constraints remain mandatory; only seal contact continuity is waived for the disturbed closure. Unknown capacity and nominal preload prevent claiming an informative feasible test in advance.

lineage.reason: Specify independent stop withdrawal and allocate twelve trials so both configurations include disturbance while the candidate receives ten opening cycles.
